description.value: Caffe Americano is a community-rooted café and restaurant in downtown Trail, BC, established in 2001 and named in tribute to victims of the 9/11 attacks. The kitchen produces a wide range of house-made food — from wood-fired pizzas and Italian-inspired burgers to fresh daily baking, soups, and gourmet take-home meals — alongside a full espresso and smoothie bar. The same building houses Esposito's Boutique Hotel, with suites overlooking the Columbia River in the heart of a Kootenay cycling hub.
